description: Agent-based, network-embedded simulation of mask adoption and usage dynamics driven by social influence, perceived risk, policies/enforcement, and retail supply/price constraints across regions and location contexts.

modules.name: NetworkAndMobilityModule
modules.description: Construct and maintain the social network (small-world) and generate daily mobility assignments to locations by time share and capacity.

notes: Network constructed once unless dynamic rewiring is later enabled.
Mobility uses time_in_* shares; stochastic assignment may be batched by region and location type.

modules.name: PopulationInitializationModule
modules.description: Initialize agents' socio-demographics, attitudes, inventories, and initial infection status.

update_rule.pseudocode:
set RNG seed
create Persons with attributes drawn from specified distributions
partition into Households using size distribution; set combined_budget = sum member budgets
draw initial mask_attitude ~ Normal(logit(initial_mask_adoption_rate), 1) truncated to [0,1] via sigmoid
set mask_usage_state = Bernoulli(initial_mask_adoption_rate)
assign masks_owned = max(min_purchase_buffer_masks, round(Normal(3,1)))
randomly mark seed_influencers_fraction of Persons with higher influence weights (e.g., double social_norm_sensitivity)
set initial health_status = Infected for a Bernoulli(initial_prevalence) draw; else Susceptible
notes: Seed influencers serve as early adopters or vocal non-adopters depending on ideology; can be balanced or biased.

modules.name: MediaAndRiskModule
modules.description: Simulate media broadcasts, misinformation, and update individual risk perceptions using epidemic prevalence and media exposure.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each MediaChannel:
  construct message signal m ~ Normal(message_bias, message_bias_sd)
  with prob misinformation_rate, flip sign or amplify towards anti-mask direction
  effective_message = m * message_frequency
for each Person:
  exposure = sum(effective_message for channels followed) weighted by channel reach
  prevalence_signal = log1p(prevalence_by_region[person.region])
  policy_signal = signal.policy_guidance_strength[person.region]
  new_risk = (1 - lambda)*old_risk + lambda * sigmoid(alpha_r * prevalence_signal + alpha_m * exposure + alpha_p * policy_signal)
  write to signal.updated_risk_perception
notes: lambda = ln(2)/risk_perception_decay_halflife_days to implement exponential smoothing.
alpha_r, alpha_m, alpha_p are internally derived scalars; can be tied to risk_perception_weight during decision.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceModule
modules.description: Update attitudes based on peers and household norms with homophily weighting.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each Person i:
  neighbors = network_neighbors[i]
  observe mask_use among neighbors and household members
  weight by homophily: w_ij = exp(-homophily_strength * |ideology_i - ideology_j|)
  social_norm_i = EMA of observed neighbor mask_use with halflife social_norm_halflife_days using weights w_ij
  household_norm = mean(mask_usage_state of household members)
  combined_norm = 0.8*social_norm_i + 0.2*household_norm
  social_pressure_i = social_influence_weight * (combined_norm - 0.5) * social_norm_sensitivity_i
  write to signal.social_norm_pressure[i]
notes: EMA ensures stability; halflife controls memory.

modules.name: RetailMarketModule
modules.description: Restock and sell masks, adjust prices based on stock pressure and demand, enforce per-customer rationing.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each Retailer r:
  restock_amount = Binomial(n=stock_level_r, p=retailer_restock_rate_per_day) or deterministic stock_level_r*rate
  stock_level_r += restock_amount
  adjust price: price_r = max(0.1, mask_price_mean * (1 + price_adjustment_smoothness * (1 - stock_level_r / (population_region * target_inventory_days))))
for each Person i with purchase_intent > 0:
  select retailer in region with minimal price (ties random)
  allowed = min(max_sales_per_customer, desired_qty_i, retailer.stock_level)
  affordable = floor(budget_i / retailer.price)
  qty = min(allowed, affordable)
  execute transaction; update masks_owned_i, budget_i, retailer.stock_level
  log purchase
signal.stockouts_today[region] = any(retailer.stock_level == 0) by region
notes: Price adjustment heuristic approximates scarcity pricing.

modules.name: PolicyModule
modules.description: Activate mandates, set enforcement intensity, run public campaigns, and feed policy signals to locations and media.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each region r:
  mandate_active = (t >= mandate_start_day && t <= mandate_end_day)
  guidance = guidance_strength * (mandate_active ? 1 : 0.5)
  set policy_required_mask at locations in r = mandate_active
  for each location L in r:
    L.entry_check_probability = policy_check_entry_probability_base * enforcement_probability
  inspections = Binomial(num_locations_in_r, inspection_rate)
  enforcement_actions = 0
  if mandate_active:
    enforcement_actions += inspections * expected_noncompliance_rate * fine_amount (log as count, not $)
  emit signals
notes: Expected noncompliance rate can be estimated from prior day noncompliance observables or a moving average.

modules.name: DecisionAndAdoptionModule
modules.description: Compute mask-use decision from risk, social pressure, policy, costs, and fatigue; set purchase intent if inventory low.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each Person i:
  risk_term = risk_perception_weight * updated_risk_perception[i]
  social_term = social_norm_pressure[i]
  policy_term = policy_effect_weight * (mandate_active_by_region[i.region]) * (trust_in_institutions_i)
  cost_term = - cost_sensitivity * expected_cost_i (proxied by current regional avg price)
  fatigue_term = - fatigue_i
  base = logistic_intercept + logistic_slope * (risk_term + social_term + policy_term + cost_term + fatigue_term)
  p_use = sigmoid(base)
  mask_usage_state_i = Bernoulli(max(min_compliance_intent, p_use)) subject to location enforcement at entry
  update fatigue_i += compliance_fatigue_rate if mask_usage_state_i==1 else -fatigue_recovery_rate; clip to [0, 1]
  desired_inventory = target_inventory_days * mask_usage_state_i
  purchase_intent_i = max(0, desired_inventory - masks_owned_i)
notes: Expected cost can be smoothed average price in region.
Fatigue accumulates with use, recovers otherwise.

modules.name: EpidemicUpdateModule
modules.description: Update prevalence based on contact rates, mask usage, and exogenous incidence; produce trend signal.

update_rule.pseudocode:
effective_mask_rate = mean(mask_usage_state weighted by time_in_locations)
transmission_multiplier = (1 - mask_efficacy_against_transmission * effective_mask_rate)
new_incidence = exogenous_incidence_rate * transmission_multiplier * (contact_rate_baseline)
prevalence = prevalence * prevalence_trend_inertia + (1 - prevalence_trend_inertia) * new_incidence
trend = prevalence - prev_prevalence
notes: This is a stylized proxy, not a full SEIR.
Weights by location contact intensity can refine effective_mask_rate.

modules.name: AggregationAndMetricsModule
modules.description: Aggregate daily observables and compute evaluation metrics over time.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate_daily = mean(mask_usage_state)
context_specific_compliance_rate = by location type, mean(mask_usage_state among entrants)
stockout_frequency_daily = indicator(any stockout today)
enforcement_actions_count_daily = count(enforcement_actions_log)
avg_masks_purchased_per_capita_daily = sum(qty in purchases_log)/population_size
inequality_index_daily = Gini( mask_usage_state by income quintiles )
estimated_transmission_reduction_daily = mask_efficacy_against_transmission * adoption_rate_daily
update time_to_70 if first day adoption_rate_daily >= adoption_threshold_high
notes: Gini computed on group means across income quintiles yields inequality in adoption.
Transmission reduction is a proxy consistent with model structure.

algorithms.WattsStrogatz: Construct small-world social network with N nodes, k average degree, and rewiring probability p.
algorithms.LogisticDecision: p = sigmoid(beta0 + beta1*x); draw Bernoulli(p) for binary mask-use decision.
algorithms.EMA: Exponential moving average for social norm and risk smoothing with specified halflife.
algorithms.ScarcityPricing: Adjust price proportionally to stock pressure: p = p0 * (1 + s*(1 - stock/target)).
algorithms.GiniIndexByQuintile: Compute G = sum_i sum_j |q_i - q_j| / (2*n^2*mean(q)) where q_i are quintile-level adoption means.
algorithms.CapacityConstrainedAssignment: Assign agents to locations respecting capacity via iterative reassignment or random thinning.
